text: July 26, 1999 - Most Nilo-Saharan languages are tonal, using pitch to indicate lexical or grammatical differences, though some border on non-tonal languages. Unlike the Afro-Asiatic family, Nilo-Saharan languages generally lack gender distinctions, with only a few exceptions in some Nilotic languages.
